title: Documentation
brief: The markdown description of a request on a Docs sub-tab (first in the row, like Postman) and of a collection in its settings section: rendered view with Edit, multi-line editor with Done or Save and Cancel, and the empty state.

artboards.title: Docs tab and collection description
artboards.tradeoff: One block for requests and collections, so the view, the editor and the empty state read the same; a request edits its draft (Done, then Ctrl+S) while a collection writes on Save
